title: Python Data Engineer – MLS CSV ingestion + geocoding + daily data pipeline
description: Project Description We are building a small internal real-estate acquisition pipeline in Python. We already have a working underwriting / scoring model that computes: • proximity tiers (Hot / Warm / Cold) • internal rent clusters (Minimal / Limited / Dense) • rent-based yield • rule-based review flags (rent restrictions, new construction, etc.) We need a developer to build the data ingestion and geocoding layer that feeds this model. This is a file-based ETL project (CSV in / CSV out). No scraping and no UI. ⸻ Scope of work 1. Read an initial MLS CSV export (“baseline” file) 2. Read daily MLS CSV exports (“delta” files) • new listings • modified listings 3. Merge baseline and daily deltas into a rolling master dataset (keyed by MLS number) 4. Build a geocoding step using the Geoapify API • only geocode addresses that do not already exist in a cache • store geocoded results in a local cache file (CSV or sqlite) 5. Merge latitude / longitude back into the master dataset 6. Preserve manual review overrides • a separate CSV file will be provided • manual review values must always override automated values 7. Call an existing Python underwriting / scoring model (provided) after ingestion and geocoding 8. Export a refreshed master CSV on each run ⸻ Configuration and future updates (important) The pipeline must be designed so that: • MLS input CSV files can be replaced with new exports (for example when search filters change) without code changes • Horizon rent and Horizon geocode datasets can be replaced monthly as input files without code changes • no hard-coded assumptions about the number of rows, properties, or files exist The script should treat all datasets as configurable inputs. ⸻ Important constraints • No web scraping • No browser automation • No UI or dashboards • No cloud infrastructure required • Script must run locally from the command line • File-based workflow only (CSV input and output) • Column mappings must be easy to adjust ⸻ Deliverables • Python script(s) to run the pipeline end-to-end • Geocode cache logic • Daily merge logic (baseline + deltas) • Manual override merge logic • Output master CSV • Short README with setup and run instructions ⸻ What we will provide • Example baseline MLS CSV • Example daily delta CSV files • Existing Python underwriting / scoring model • Horizon rent and geocode datasets • Geoapify API key • Folder structure specification ⸻ Required skills • Python • pandas • ETL / data pipelines • REST API integration ⸻ Nice to have • Experience working with real-estate or MLS-style datasets ⸻ Project type Fixed-price project with two milestones. Milestone 1 • baseline + delta merge working • geocode cache implemented • master dataset produced Milestone 2 • integration with existing underwriting model • manual override logic • final outputs and documentation

title: Local Business Scraper
description: Project Overview We’re a pest control company building a partnership outreach list for referral programs in the Northeast. We need a contractor to scrape and verify B2B contact data for specific business categories and regions. The output will power email plus phone outreach to set up cross referral partnerships. Target Geographies New Jersey Upstate New York Long Island, NY Connecticut Eastern Pennsylvania Philadelphia metro and surrounding suburbs Target Business Types include ALL that apply Plant Nurseries and Garden Centers Important NOT child nurseries or daycare. Those must be excluded. Landscaping Companies and Landscape Maintenance and Landscape Design Build HOAs and Property Management Companies managing HOAs Real Estate Residential brokerages and individual agents focused on single family homes Data Fields Required one row per company or agent Company Level or HOA Business Name Primary Category Nursery, Landscaping, HOA or Property Mgmt, Real Estate Brokerage Street Address, City, State, ZIP Website URL General Contact Email Main Phone County if available Notes e.g., mentions tick or mosquito, offers lawn maintenance, etc. Primary Contact for each business First Name Last Name Title or Role Owner, President, GM, HOA Community Manager, Broker or Owner, Agent Direct Email non generic preferred Direct Phone if available LinkedIn URL nice to have Output Format CSV plus Google Sheet with separate columns; UTF-8; one tab per category is OK. Provide a data dictionary column definitions. Include a Source URL column for every record. Quality and Validation Requirements No duplicates dedupe across categories and regions. Active businesses only verify website or recent online presence. Email validation SMTP or reputable validation API flag confidence score or status. Phone format in E.164 or parentheses ### ### #### consistently. Exclude any daycare or childcare nurseries, medical offices, or irrelevant categories. Include at least one contact per company owner or decision maker preferred. Geo check ensure businesses are physically located in the specified regions. Sources and Methods guidance Public directories Google Maps, Apple Maps, Bing Places, state business registries Industry directories garden center or nursery associations, local chamber or HOA management lists Real estate brokerage sites plus agent rosters, Zillow or Realtor.com profile pages where permitted LinkedIn for names and titles, company About or Team pages No scraping behind paywalls or violating site ToS. Respect robots.txt and rate limits. Estimated Volume Goal approximately 3,000 to 6,000 high quality rows across all categories you may propose an initial pilot. Suggested split target flexible Plant Nurseries 600 to 1,000 Landscaping Companies 1,500 to 3,000 HOAs or Property Mgmt 400 to 800 Real Estate brokerages plus agents 500 to 1,200 Deliverables Clean, validated CSV plus Google Sheet with all required fields. Source list and brief method notes how you gathered data. Deduplication report criteria used plus counts removed. Email validation report method plus status codes. Weekly progress file incremental CSV until completion. Compliance and Ethics Must comply with CAN SPAM and applicable data or privacy laws. Only collect publicly available business contact info. We will use this list for B2B partnership outreach not consumer marketing. NDA required; data is for our internal use only. Tech Stack preferred, not required Python Requests, BeautifulSoup or Scrapy, Selenium or Playwright as needed Google Maps API, validation APIs for example NeverBounce, ZeroBounce, Clearbit or People Data Labs if permitted Delivery via Google Drive plus Git repo optional with reproducible scripts Timeline and Budget Propose timeline and fixed price for Pilot of 250 rows balanced across categories Full rollout based on pilot acceptance Include cost per additional 1,000 records as an option. Sample Schema copy into your sheet category | business_name | street | city | state | zip | county | website | main_phone | general_email | contact_first | contact_last | title | contact_email | contact_phone | linkedin_url | source_url | email_status | notes What to Include in Your Proposal Brief description of your scraping approach and quality controls Three relevant past projects B2B list building in the U.S. preferred Sample of 10 to 20 rows matching our schema for one geography e.g., NJ nurseries Tools or APIs you plan to use plus rate limiting or anti blocking strategy Confirmation you can exclude childcare nurseries and dedupe across categories Screening Questions How will you distinguish plant nurseries from childcare nurseries at scale What’s your process to find owner or decision maker emails when only a contact form is listed Which validation steps will you run before delivery Share a quick pseudocode outline or repo link for your scraper architecture What’s your estimated accuracy for direct owner emails vs generic inboxes Acceptance Criteria for final delivery At least 90 percent valid websites, at least 85 percent deliverable emails post validation, and under 2 percent duplicates All records have category, address, website, phone, and one contact with name plus title Clear provenance source_url for each row Data matches only the specified geographies and business types Childcare or daycare nurseries are fully excluded
